chatglm.cn.note: Auth is cookie-based: chatglm_token (access, SameSite=None Secure, 30d), chatglm_refresh_token (180d), chatglm_user_id. Refresh via POST /chatglm/user-api/user/refresh with Bearer refresh_token. Catalog kind=cookie credentialName=chatglm_session (OmniRoute naming: chatglm-web).

chat.z.ai.note: Auth is localStorage JWT key 'token', set from GET /api/v1/auths/ session.token; no refresh token literal found. Login route /auth?action=signup.

note: This package installs and runs from the profile plus captured session snapshots. Two distinct auth models: chatglm.cn (cookies chatglm_token/chatglm_refresh_token) vs chat.z.ai (localStorage token). Capture both once, then this file records the snapshot hashes + dates. Exact wire formats (zh stream_context response; intl chat/completions SSE chunk shape) TBD on first live capture.
